# Block `practice`

**Use:** A few practice tasks with checks: `select` (choose from options), `text` (accepted answers) or `open` (self-checked against the solution).

**Avoid:** Answers in `select` that are not among its options.

## Example

```json
{
  "kind": "practice",
  "id": "practice-indexes",
  "tasks": [
    {
      "id": "p1",
      "prompt": "Which structure answers `WHERE age BETWEEN 20 AND 30` best?",
      "check": {
        "mode": "select",
        "options": [
          "Hash index",
          "B+ tree"
        ],
        "answer": [
          "B+ tree"
        ]
      },
      "solution": "A B+ tree keeps keys sorted, so a range is one scan.",
      "hint": "Which one keeps keys in order?"
    },
    {
      "id": "p2",
      "prompt": "Explain in one sentence why indexes slow down inserts.",
      "check": {
        "mode": "open"
      },
      "solution": "Every insert must also update each index."
    }
  ],
  "source": [
    {
      "file": "slides.pdf",
      "page": 4
    }
  ]
}
```

## Fields

| Field | Type | Required |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `kind` | `"practice"` | yes |
| `source` | array of object (1–5) | no |
| `source[].file` | string | yes |
| `source[].page` | integer (≤ 9007199254740991) | yes |
| `id` | string (pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$`) | yes |
| `tasks` | array of object | yes |
| `tasks[].id` | string (pattern `^[A-Za-z0-9][A-Za-z0-9._-]*$`) | yes |
| `tasks[].prompt` | string | yes |
| `tasks[].check` | object \| object \| object | yes |
| `tasks[].solution` | string | yes |
| `tasks[].hint` | string | no |

Every block may carry `source`: 1–5 `{ "file", "page" }` references to the material it came from.
